title: Fractions, one piece at a time
description: Start with equal pieces of one whole. Learn to read, compare and add fractions using pictures you can change.
introduction:
Start with equal pieces of one whole. Learn to read, compare and add fractions using pictures you can change.

Change the examples, check your predictions and take the short quiz at the end of each lesson. You can return to any chapter whenever you like.
prerequisites: Comfort with counting, addition and equal sharing. Maths from zero is a useful starting point.

lessons.objective: Recognise equal parts of the same whole.
Explain the numerator and denominator using a picture.
Show why different fractions can describe the same amount.
Add fractions whose pieces have the same size.

outcomes: Recognise equal parts of the same whole.
Explain the numerator and denominator using a picture.
Show why different fractions can describe the same amount.
Add fractions whose pieces have the same size.

glossary.definition: The complete amount used as the reference.
The number of selected equal parts.
The number of equal parts making one whole.
Describing the same amount, even with different-sized pieces.
